'''Whitefennel''' is an [[herbs|herb]] that can be found in the [[Two Rivers]] region and in [[Tear]]. A little whitefennel can be given to a birthing mother to aid her during a particularly difficult labor.{{ref/book|3|49}}

Whitefennel should not be confused with [[gray fennel]], which is poisonous.{{ref/book|2|23}}{{ref/book|9|10}}
